angolo: Gemini Wins by 12 Points, Kimi Offers Open Weights
descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) edges Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) in Arena chat votes. See scores, strengths, hardware fit and free use options.
intro: Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) leads in the Arena blind chat test. It scores 1497 points while Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) scores 1485. The 12-point gap means about 52 % of voters prefer Gemini.

sezioni.testo: Arena scores are based on blind human votes. Two anonymous answers compete and voters pick the better one. Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) earned a chat score of 1497. Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) earned 1485. The 12-point gap translates to roughly 52 % of voters choosing Gemini.

In the chat category Gemini stays ahead with 1497 points. Kimi trails with 1485 points. In coding, Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) takes the lead with 1686 points against Gemini's 1583. Each model shines in a different area.

The scores show that Gemini is stronger for general conversation. Kimi excels when coding assistance is needed.

Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) lists a size of 2780.1 B and an active portion of 104.8 B. A 4-bit download is about 1686 GB. The model has open weights and can be run locally. However, it does not fit the listed RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, or Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB hardware.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) does not publish its size. The model is marked online only for all listed hardware. It cannot be run at home on those machines.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) can be accessed through Google’s free API tier. The license is proprietary. It cannot be tried on FreeLLMArena's Try & compare page.

Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) is available as a download. Users can run it at home under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License. It also cannot be tried on FreeLLMArena's Try & compare page.

verdetto: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) if you want the higher chat preference and a ready-to-use free API. Pick Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) if you need open weights and are willing to manage a large download for local use.
